public/channel-switcher.js.reason: Routing-only shell API for the shared native-component Updates tab; same preference key, confirmation and navigation semantics. Requires independent content review.

electron/build.mjs.reason: CSP hashes cover both app shells; no native storage format change.

package.json.reason: Build/check commands only; dependency declarations and stored formats unchanged.

src/components/sidebarLeft/tabs/phantomc.reason: Presentation-only Updates tab using Row, RadioField, RadioForm and SettingSection. No database access; delegates routing to the shell. Copied to pinned Stable by the builder. Independent desktop installer ring remains accessible.

src/helpers/themeController.ts.reason: Restore original Stable UI colours; reverse prior stock Preview palette at render time only, preserving custom settings and persisted data. Independent review remains required.

src/helpers/understatedTheme.ts.reason: Restore original Stable UI colours; reverse prior stock Preview palette at render time only, preserving custom settings and persisted data. Independent review remains required.

src/components/sidebarLeft/foldersSideba.reason: Adds the Code rail entry plus a boot restore of an OPTIONAL StateSettings flag (absence reads as off) and mounts the inbox on demand. The folder rail, filter ids and folder storage are unchanged.
Pure display helper: optional filter.emoticon fallback for the folder icon; All Chats never uses it. No storage writes.

src/components/sidebarLeft/tabs/editFold.reason: Edit-folder UI gains an icon picker stored on the existing dialogFilter.emoticon schema field; icon clear assigns empty string instead of deleting the property. Optional field on the FiltersStorage/FoldersSync JSON blob, which old channels copy through opaquely; no migration, no schema change.

src/config/state.ts.reason: Adds two OPTIONAL StateSettings keys (defaultChatFolderId, codeModeEnabled). Nothing is migrated, absent means off/default, and an older channel that never writes them is unaffected.

src/helpers/dom/createFolderContextMenu..reason: Context-menu actions that write the optional defaultChatFolderId settings key and toast. No storage format change.

src/lang.ts.reason: New UI strings only; no behaviour change.

src/lib/appDialogsManager.ts.reason: Startup tab selection reads the optional defaultChatFolderId settings key (falls back to All Chats when absent) and clears it on filter_delete. No dialog storage or storage format change.

src/lib/folders-default.ts.reason: New pure module: startup-folder decision helpers and launch-hash capture. No I/O, no storage access.

src/scripts/out/langPack.strings.reason: Generated from lang.ts by src/scripts/format_lang.js; strings only.

src/components/addToFolderDropdownMenu/h.reason: Display-only: add-to-folder menu icon now consults the picked folder emoticon first (pick > title emoji/docId > built-in). Reads an optional filter field; no storage format change.

src/lib/phantomchat/phantomchat-launch-d.reason: Doc-only tweak to isChatDeepLink JSDoc (returns true for any non-trivial launch hash, not only chat deep links). No code or storage change.

src/components/phantomchat/codeInbox.tsx.reason: New code-mode inbox view. It READS the existing phantom mapping store and the cached dialogs and writes nothing at all; no stored format, key or migration changes.

src/components/phantomchat/codePhantomOp.reason: New PhantomOps panel. Persists one namespaced localStorage key (the PhantomOps API key) and talks to /api/chat/*; it never touches IndexedDB, StateSettings or any channel-owned store.

src/lib/code-mode.ts.reason: New file: device-local mode plumbing (one optional StateSettings flag + a body class) and the pure inbox list builder. No filter/folder storage and no Nostr sync.

src/lib/phantomchat/code-mode-phantomops.reason: New file: the PhantomOps HTTP client. Persists exactly one namespaced localStorage key (the API key); no IndexedDB, no channel storage, no wire format change.

src/lib/rootScope.ts.reason: Adds one BroadcastEvents entry (code_mode_changed: boolean) to the typed event map. Event plumbing only; no runtime or storage behaviour change.
